description:
Wi Han-young, a construction company CEO carrying the scars of childhood, collapses from a panic attack and is saved by pharmacist Han Jae-oh. The two are mysteriously drawn to one another and quickly fall in love. But someone who sees their relationship as a thorn in the side begins plotting in secret to drag them both into ruin... Can their love survive unscathed?
